title: Certificate body
description: The Academy's certificate (academy.md section 3, register rows DK25 and DK27): the Registrar attests that a holder passed an exam in a skill at a level. Signed by the Registrar. It rests on a passed exam result (the log checks it); it lasts at most 180 days; it can be revoked (certificate_revocation). Level 1 with skill foundations is the Foundations certificate; level 2 or more in another skill is a Practitioner certificate. A tier already reached is not lost at expiry. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits never buy a certificate's standing.

exam_result.description: The passed exam result this certificate rests on. The log checks it is a passed result of the holder for this skill and level, and used for one certificate only.
